d: Winning individual awards is one thing, but what happens when the competition for personal recognition starts affecting a relationship inside the same national team? Reports of a rift between Kylian Mbappe and Ousmane Dembele have put France's attacking partnership under the spotlight, particularly after their Ballon d'Or rivalry and contrasting journeys at PSG and Real Madrid. Rupha Ramani dives deep into the discomfort surrounding the two French footballers, Mbappe's responsibilities as captain and why Zinedine Zidane's man-management skills could be crucial ahead of the FIFA World Cup…
